title: Intent
description: Work bigger than one Spec: what a person wants, in their words, with its goal, and its slices grouped into phases. A person agrees to it before Specify starts on a slice, and each slice becomes a Spec when its work starts. The team writes it from a request, the person's own words. Aliases: Theme, Program.

title.description: One line. The language in the project's AGENTS.md may apply.

request.description: The request it answers, the person's own words: a path, such as `BRIEF.md` or a saved chat request, `specs/requests/<yyyy-mm-dd>-<slug>.md`, or a link. aidd never changes it.

status.description: Only a person closes an Intent, because only a person can say its goal is met or dropped: they set `done`, or `cancelled` to stop it. Draft and active are derived from its slices.

agreed_by.description: The person who agreed, in `approved_by`'s form, never an agent. `aidd upgrade` never writes it.

agreed_at.description: When the person agreed (RFC 3339). A slice added or removed, or a new `goal`, after it warns until they agree again.

blocked_by.description: The work items this Intent waits for before its work starts, by id: no Spec under it starts until they finish. `aidd validate` checks that they form no cycle.

delivery_team.description: The delivery team accountable for the outcome: a key of the config's `delivery_teams`, which `aidd validate` checks. Its Specs are the team's work too. A slice may name another team in its own `delivery_team`.

trace_id.description: Joins this Intent with the Specs of other repositories that deliver its slices: each sets `trace_id: <home>/<Intent id>`.

reaches.description: How the work reaches users, agreed with the Intent. `incremental` (the default): each Spec merges by itself. `flagged`: each merges behind a flag that stays off until the last slice of the last phase, whose Merge approval is the launch, which a person always decides. `batched`: the Specs build on `intent/<ID>`, which one Merge approval merges.

covers.description: The ids of the proposal needs this Intent delivers, when it came from an accepted proposal.

proposal.description: The accepted proposal this Intent delivers, so every change under it traces back to what was promised.

go_no_go.description: A person's decision to pursue the Intent or not, in the proposal's shape; `no_go` derives `cancelled`. Never an agent's.

phases.description: The phases, in order, each an ordered group of slices. An Intent with one phase lists that one.

tracker.description: The tracker's records this Intent links to, such as `{type: epic, id: PORT-31}`. aidd calls no tracker.

risks.description: The R of the RAID log, copied from the accepted proposal and kept current here.

assumptions.description: The A of the RAID log, copied from the accepted proposal and kept current here.

issues.description: The I of the RAID log, copied from the accepted proposal and kept current here.

dependencies.description: The D of the RAID log, copied from the accepted proposal and kept current here.

decisions.description: The scope decisions log, copied from the accepted proposal and kept current here. Each entry is a person's decision.
